title: Manali, Solang & Kasol
reportingPoint: Departure is in the evening from Delhi or Chandigarh. Final pickup details are shared with confirmed travellers before the trip; report at the pickup point 30 minutes early.
highlights: Hadimba Temple, Old Manali and Mall Road

Kasol cafes, flea market and the 3 km riverside trail to Chalal
Manikaran Sahib Gurudwara and its hot springs
overview:
Snow and chill vibes in one long weekend: this **3 Nights / 4 Days** group trip leaves Delhi or Chandigarh every Friday evening for an overnight journey to Manali.

Day 1 covers Hadimba Temple, Old Manali and Mall Road, with dinner by a bonfire. Day 2 takes in Solang Valley on the way up, drives through the Atal Tunnel and stops for the views at Sissu. Day 3 drives to Kasol via Kullu for another bonfire night. Day 4 is for Kasol's cafes and market, the 3 km riverside trail to Chalal and Manikaran Sahib Gurudwara before the evening departure; you reach Delhi by noon the next day. Two nights in a Manali hotel, one night in Kasol, 6 meals and a trip captain are included. Prices start at ₹8,500 per person on quad sharing (5% GST extra).

itinerary.title: Departure from Delhi / Chandigarh
itinerary.content:
Assemble at the pickup point in Delhi or Chandigarh, meet your team captain and the group.
Depart in the evening for the overnight journey to Manali in an AC Tempo Traveller or bus.
Halt for dinner on the way (not included).

itinerary.title: Reach Manali | Hadimba Temple | Old Manali | Mall Road
itinerary.content:
Reach Manali in the morning, check in at the hotel and freshen up.
Local sightseeing: Hadimba Temple, Old Manali and Mall Road.
Back to the hotel for dinner with a bonfire and light music.
Overnight stay in Manali.

itinerary.title: Solang Valley | Atal Tunnel | Sissu
itinerary.content:
After breakfast, head out for the day.
Cover Solang Valley en route, drive through the Atal Tunnel and enjoy the views from Sissu Valley.
Back to the hotel in the evening for dinner and overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Manali to Kasol via Kullu
itinerary.content:
Wake up early, have breakfast and check out.
Leave for Kasol via Kullu, reaching in the evening.
Check in, then dinner with a bonfire and light music.
Overnight stay in Kasol.

itinerary.title: Kasol | Chalal | Manikaran Sahib | Departure
itinerary.content:
Wake up early, have breakfast and check out.
Explore the Kasol market and cafes, and walk to Chalal village (a 3 km riverside trail, both ways).
Visit Manikaran Sahib Gurudwara, famous for its hot water spring.
Depart in the evening for the overnight journey home.
Reach Delhi by noon the next day.

faqs.q: Where and when does the trip start?

faqs.q: How much does the Manali, Solang & Kasol trip cost?

faqs.q: How do I book and pay?
faqs.a: Reserve your seat with a ₹3,000 advance per person (UPI, GPay, PhonePe, Paytm or net banking) and pay the rest 24 hours before boarding. 5% GST is extra on the trip price.
The ₹3,000 advance is not refunded under any circumstances. There are no refunds for inclusions you don't use, and bookings can't be transferred.

faqs.q: What do I need to carry?
faqs.a: A valid government photo ID is a must: there is no boarding without it. Also pack a down or main jacket, thermals, socks and gloves, outdoor shoes, a daypack and personal medication. The full list is under Things To Pack.
